title: 여름 햇살과 바이올린: 개미와 베짱이의 따뜻한 겨울
author: 뮤토책방

villagePlace.description: 달콤한 음악 소리와 맛있는 먹이가 가득한 정다운 숲속 언덕이에요.
villagePlace.name: 도토리 음악 언덕

summary: 여름 내내 노래한 베짱이와 부지런한 개미들의 따뜻한 겨울 이야기예요.

pages.full_text: 햇살이 눈부시게 쏟아지는 여름날, 초록빛 풀밭에 즐거운 음악 소리가 울려 퍼졌어요. 랄랄라~ 깡충! 초록 옷을 입은 베짱이가 풀잎 위에서 신나게 바이올린을 켜고 있었지요. "안녕, 친구들! 오늘 날씨 정말 최고지? 음악에 맞춰 춤추자!"

english.childEnglishTitle: Summer Sunshine and the Violin: The Warm Winter of the Ant and the Grasshopper

childEnglishPages.full_text: It was a bright, sunny summer day. Joyful music filled the green grass. La-la-la, hop! A grasshopper in green clothes was playing his violin. He was having so much fun. "Hello, friends! The weather is great today! Let's dance to the music!"

dialogue_list.text: On a bright summer day, joyful music filled the green grass.
Hello, friends! The weather is great today! Let's dance to the music!
Just then, a busy little friend walked by. It was an ant in blue overalls!
Heave-ho! Phew, I am sweating! But I must get ready for winter!

childEnglishPages.full_text: Just then, a little friend walked by. It was an ant in blue overalls! He carried a sweet grain of corn. The grain was twice as big as him! "Phew, I am sweating so much. But I must get ready for winter!"

The grasshopper saw the ant sweating. He came close and asked, "Ant, why are you working so hard? It is such a nice day! Take a rest and listen to my song!" But the ant shook his head. "If we do not save food now, we will be hungry in winter. Why don't you collect some food, too?"

dialogue_list.text: Ant, why are you working so hard on a nice day? Take a rest and listen to my song!
We will be hungry in the cold winter. Why don't you collect some food, too?

childEnglishPages.full_text: The grasshopper tilted his head. "Winter is far away! My music cheers up tired friends!" He played a cheerful tune again. Suddenly, the ant felt light and happy. "Oh! Your song gives me energy! Thank you, Grasshopper!"

dialogue_list.text: Winter is far away! My music cheers up tired friends!
The grasshopper played a cheerful tune. Amazingly, the ant felt light and happy.
Oh! Your song gives me energy! Thank you, Grasshopper!

childEnglishPages.full_text: Time passed, and white snow began to fall. The cold wind blew, whoosh! The whole meadow froze. Everything was covered in white, and there was no food left. Brrr! The grasshopper was shivering. "I am so cold and hungry... The ant was right. What should I do?"

dialogue_list.text: Time passed, and white snow began to fall. The cold wind blew and froze the grass.
Brrr! I am so cold and hungry... The ant was right. What should I do?
The grasshopper was brave and knocked on the ant's door.
Hello, Ant... It is so cold outside, and I have no food. Can you help me, please?

childEnglishPages.full_text: The grasshopper walked down the hill. He knocked on the ant's door. Knock, knock! The door opened, and warm, delicious smells came out. "Hello, Ant... It is so cold outside, and I have no food. Can you help me, please?" The grasshopper looked down.

dialogue_list.text: Come in, Grasshopper! I was waiting for you!
The ant gave him warm soup and soft bread.
Your beautiful violin gave me strength. That is how I collected all this food!

childEnglishPages.full_text: The ant held the grasshopper's hands. He led him inside quickly. "Come in, Grasshopper! I was waiting for you!" The ant gave him warm soup and soft bread. "In the summer, your beautiful violin gave me strength. That is how I collected all this food!"

The grasshopper was warm now. He smiled with tears in his eyes. "Thank you, Ant! Next year, I will work hard with you. Now, I will play winter music for you!" Warm music filled the cozy house. Hard work and sweet music were both wonderful gifts.

dialogue_list.text: Thank you, Ant! Next year, I will work hard with you. Now, I will play winter music for you!
Warm music filled the cozy house. Hard work and sweet music were both wonderful gifts.
